sentences.text: Learned counsel for applicants submits that subsequent to the F.I.R. dated 03.04.2018 lodged by first informant/opposite party-2, giving rise to present criminal proceedings, the prosecutrix has solemnized marriage with applicant.
As such, the prosecutrix is the legally wedded wife of applicant.
The prosecutrix is residing with applicant as his legally wedded wife.
Bonafide of applicant is further explicit from the fact that the prosecutrix has herself sworn the affidavit filed in support of this application.
On the above premise, the learned counsel for applicant submits that in view of the subsequent development, the criminality, if any, committed by applicant now stands washed off.
As such, no useful purpose shall be served in prolonging the criminal prosecution of applicant.
From the wedlock of applicant and the prosecutrix, a son and a daughter were born.
He therefore submits that in case the criminal prosecution of applicant is allowed to continue, a happy family shall stand broken.
He, therefore, submits that present application is liable to be allowed.
5. Per Contra, the learned A.G.A. representing State-opposite party-2 has vehemently opposed the present application.

He submits that since the prosecutrix was a child within the definition of the term child as defined in the POCSO Act, therefore, the subsequent development, if any, will not wipe out the criminality committed by the applicant.
As such, no interference is warranted by this Court in present application.
However, he could not dislodge the factual and legal submissions urged by the learned counsel for applicants with reference to the record.

6. Mrs. Nirma Mishra, the learned counsel representing first informant/opposite party-2 i.e. mother of the prosecutrix, upon instructions received by her submits that she has instruction not to oppose this application.
She also admits that marriage of applicant was solemnized with the prosecutrix, out of which, two children were born.
She, therefore, contends that she does not have any objection in case the present application is decided taking into consideration the aforementioned facts.

7. Having heard the learned counsel for applicant, the learned A.G.A. for State-opposite party-1,
Mrs. Nirma Mishra, the learned counsel representing first informant/opposite party-2 and upon perusal of record this court finds that it is admitted to the parties that after the F.I.R. dated 03.04.2018 was lodged by first informant/opposite party-2 (mother of the prosecutrix), the marriage of the prosecutrix was solemnized with applicant.

Consequently, the prosecutrix is now the Shekhar Alias Sagar vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 8 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/149767634/
2 legally wedded wife of applicant.

8. In view of the discussion made above, the present application succeeds and is liable to be allowed.

9. It is accordingly allowed.
